180.long_description: We are constantly working on new development products, and sharing the products to engineers, reviewers, as well as, using our products for trade events. These arcade machines and components are now available to be purchased at greatly discounted prices. Many of our products have long development times - not only are we revising the hardware, but often we are revising the software. Then, we share the products to various independent testers and engineers to review and help up further improve the products. Whilst we handle our own inhouse development work, our focus is both on the arcade industry and digital display marketplace. When customers use our monitor (for example) with a Japanese PC (Sharp X68000) made in 1987, we need to work on new firmware. These samples, development products, trade event products, tester units and second standard products (such as monitors that have 1-3 problem pixels) are now available for purchase from the below link; https://www.arcooda.com/clearance If you are interested to purchase, send us a message with the product you are interested in, and your full delivery address, and we will recheck the local transport costs and also give you guide if the goods can ship immediately or the release date.
